newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested.
Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers with bids at $66.00 per cwt and asking prices $68.00-$69.00. Last established market was a light test Friday at $68.00.
There were 21,800 head confirmed for the week to date including 21,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Offerings expected to show an increase over last week's numbers. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
